about_the_game:
Land of the Valiants is a multiplayer online RPG set in a vast medieval fantasy world where courage, strategy, and honor define the fate of nations. Build your character and explore ancient ruins, enchanted forests, and war-torn kingdoms.

Customize your warrior with unique armor sets, weapons, and abilities. Face dynamic PvE challenges and engage in real-time PvP battles that test your skill and teamwork. As you rise through the ranks, your choices will shape alliances, trigger wars, and define your legacy across the land.

Whether you’re leading armies, defending your homeland, or forging a path as a lone mercenary, Land of the Valiants offers a deep, evolving experience for adventurers who dare to carve their name into history.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized cartoon violence typical of fantasy RPGs. Combat includes the use of swords, magic, and ranged weapons, with visual effects such as flashes and magical impacts. The game does not include sexual content, drug use, or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Performance may vary depending on server load and player density.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for optimal loading times and streaming performance.

short_description: Land of the Valiants is a medieval fantasy MMORPG where players explore, battle, and forge their legacy through real-time PvP, dynamic PvE, and full character customization.
